import RNA, random
target = "...(((((((....((..((..(((..((..((..((..((..((..((...)).))..)).)).))..)).))).)).)))))))))........(((((((....((..((..(((..((..((..((..((..((..((...)).))..)).)).))..)).))).)).)))))))))..."
pair={}; st=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': st.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=st.pop(); pair[j]=i; pair[i]=j
# use mixed pairs: alternate GC/CG and AU to reduce over-strong stems
def init():
    seq=['A']*len(target)
    seen=set()
    for i,c in enumerate(target):
        if i in pair and i not in seen:
            j=pair[i]
            seen.add(i); seen.add(j)
            choice = random.choice(['GC','CG','AU','UA'])
            a,b = choice[0],choice[1]
            seq[i]=a; seq[j]=b
    return ''.join(seq)

best=None; bestscore=1e9
for it in range(20000):
    s=init()
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    mfe,e=fc.mfe()
    if mfe==target:
        # compute distance
        d=RNA.bp_distance(mfe,target)
        if d<bestscore:
            bestscore=d; best=s
            print("SOLVED", it)
            break
    d=RNA.bp_distance(mfe,target)
    if d<bestscore:
        bestscore=d; best=s
print("best dist", bestscore)
print(best)
